newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ship sinks off Malaysia; one dead, 18 rescued.
newsitem.headline: Ship sinks off Malaysia; one dead, 18 rescued.

text.p: One person was found dead on a Malaysian cargo ship, MV Rajah Mas, that sank on Monday after running aground off Sarawak on Borneo island, the Maritime Rescue and Coordination Centre (MRCC) said on Tuesday.
Eighteen people were rescued and moved to hospital in Sarawak's capital Kuching, Captain Abdul Rahim bin Akob, director of MRCC in Sarawak, told Reuters by telephone.
"She ran aground and eventually water seeped in. She took in water and sank about two miles (3.2 km) west of Tanjung Jerijeh lighthouse," he said.
MRCC said the 1,000 deadweight tonne ship was carrying about 187 tonnes of general cargo from Kuching to Sarikei, a river port within the state.
The ship was registered in Kuching and plied between ports in Sarawak and neighbouring Sabah state.
The statement said it was not known why the vessel ran aground.
The national Bernama news agency said the ship sank in bad weather at the mouth of the river Rejang.
